meta.notes: Campus paintball: spawn A (west, x=-51, blue) vs spawn B (east, x=+51, yellow); play area 110x80 m inside a stone wall + net. Chapel + tower at the centre blocks the long axis; brick halls on the north flank (back alley behind them); the curving road across the south is the open danger lane. Godot axes: north (halls) is -Z, the road is toward +Z. Gameplay mirrors about x=0; bushes are HIDE_ walk-through volumes, tree trunks thin COL_ cover.
